mechanics.claim: Lightslinger is triggered by casting an ability and consumed by Lucian's next basic attack, even if the second shot ends up with no target.
mechanics.quote: ''Lightslinger'' is triggered and consumed by the first attack, even if no target can be found upon firing the second attack.

mechanics.claim: The second shot fires 0.25 seconds after the triggering basic attack.
mechanics.quote: fires an additional shot {{tip|on-attack}} after {{fd|0.25}} seconds

mechanics.claim: The second shot applies life steal and on-hit effects, triggers on-attack effects, and separately rolls a critical strike.
mechanics.quote: The second shot {{tip|applies life steal|applies}} {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}} and {{tip|on-hit}} effects, triggers {{tip|on-attack}} effects, and is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers.

mechanics.claim: The second attack is a separate hit for on-hit proc effects such as Electrocute, Muramana Shock, and Eclipse.
mechanics.quote: The second attack counts as a separate hit for effects such as {{ri|Electrocute}}, {{iis|Muramana}} {{nie|Shock}}, and {{iis|Eclipse}} {{nie|Ever Rising Moon}}.

mechanics.claim: Vigilance's empowered shots are granted when Lucian is healed or shielded by an ally, or when an enemy champion within 1000 units is immobilized.
mechanics.quote: Whenever '''Lucian''' is {{tip|heal|healed}} or {{tip|shield|shielded}} by an ally, or an enemy champion within 1000 units is {{tip|immobilized}}, his next two shots within 6 seconds are empowered

mechanics.claim: Lucian can act freely while the second shot fires.
mechanics.quote: '''Lucian''' can perform actions freely while firing ''Lightslinger's'' second attack.
